column1: # Rows db.hr1.* (line DBID hr-1, 2026-11-25; DECISIONS 62 (27)): NCBI's places at each load of a reported subject (the scope's cache and index, the data loader's m_Ids, the lookup; report::db_subject::ScopeWalk). Fixtures in multidb: zq7nH (R/pfoff/p4/review4/db), zhApP, zhBpP, zpApP (R/hr/bin/mkfix_hr.py), zlxL and nq_XB.fna, nq_X.fna (its first query) (R/hr/bin/hr1open.py --mkfix), pq_U.faa and nq_2.fna (mixdb2 review1), made with makeblastdb 2.17.0 -parse_seqids. Kind ncbi rows are frozen from NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0; the losat-rejection rows are holds that NCBI writes (exit 0), refused until hr-2 writes the holder's record.

column12: line DBID hr-1 (review 4 nf of pfoff-4, M1): a lookup that does not fail (vnP's unversioned ref|NM_100001|, prefetch off) beside zq7nH, whose line 1 holds ref|NP_100001.1| and line 2 gi|7109 (its Seq-align id): its Bioseq is made by line 2, so neither the scope nor m_Ids holds the subject's id and NCBI writes the subject; dev's static scan of every line refused it
